Vector quantization underlies image and audio generation and even recommendation SIDs, but the common VQ-VAE codebook often collapses, leaving most codewords unused. FlowVQ (a flow-matching-based vector quantization method) first cuts a fixed simple prior distribution into cells of equal probability, one initial codeword per cell.
